verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB offers a BYOC deployment mode in which "your data never leaves your cloud or your hardware," which lets a customer control where data physically resides. The evidence never documents choosing a region or residency for the fully managed service, and the BYOC claim is a single thin line. Missing for 10: documented region selection for managed clusters, a list of available regions/residency guarantees (e.g., EU-only), detailed BYOC docs, independent corroboration.
